newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: UNIDO to hold technology conference in Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: UNIDO to hold technology conference in Pakistan.

text.p: The United Nations Industrial Development Organization (UNIDO) said on Friday it planned to hold an investment and technology conference in Pakistan's southern port city of Karachi in December.
A UNIDO statement said the four-day conference, called Intechmart '97, would help facilitate investment and technology transfer to developing countries.

A UNIDO official said the conference, scheduled to start on December 7, would attract an estimated 176 foreign companies interested in establishing joint ventures with local small- and medium-sized industries.

"Intechmart aims at providing support to the public/private sector of Pakistan. It is specifically designed to secure financial, technical and entrepreneurial resources from abroad for the benefit of local industry," the statement said.

The conference would focus on agro-based industries, mineral processing and petrochemicals, textile and garments, leather and leather production, infrastructure, light engineering, information technology, hotels and tourism.
UNIDO said it was being organised in collaboration with the Federation of Pakistan Chambers of Commerce and Industry, the state-run Board of Investment and the Export Promotion Bureau.
